...Even when I tried to pull myself together, I still lost the raid. There's nothing I can do. I stared at the village for a long time. The weight in my chest grew heavier 鈥?can't do anything, can't do anything. I tried my best...
Expected as much 鈥?lost the raid. Lost completely. Iron golem's dead, villagers are dead... I should've gone with them.
diary.dtt.major_depression.closing.warm: The sun has set. Today is over. I'm glad I could still write these words 鈥?it's the only thing that proves I'm still alive.
diary.dtt.major_depression.closing.nihil: And so, another day passes. I've wished a thousand times that once I close my eyes, I wouldn't have to open them again. But that's just wishful thinking. Goodnight. See you never tomorrow.
diary.dtt.major_depression.closing.succe: Well, that's enough for today's diary. Nothing more to say. The wind outside feels nice. Maybe I should go feel the breeze before sleeping.
diary.dtt.major_depression.closing.faile: Alright, that was my pathetic excuse for a day. I don't know why I write this stuff. What's the point? Yet I'm still here writing a diary. Day, after day, after day... When will there be no next day?
diary.dtt.manic_phase.opening.warm: Good morning! Haha, I'm absolutely bursting with energy today! Can't wait to see what happens 鈥?I'm gonna look at the flowers, the grass, the little animals! I'm gonna do so many things, and I won't get tired at all!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.opening.nihilistic: So excited! So excited! I couldn't sleep at all last night, just lay in bed waiting for daylight. I need to go out, I need to do so many things. Ah, well, hope I actually have that many things to do.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.opening.successful: Hahaha, today is such a~ perfect day for adventure! What treasure will I find? What monsters will I run into? I'm so hyped 鈥?my heart's pounding like it's about to jump out!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.opening.failed: Oh no! I got too excited getting out of bed this morning and jumped up too fast, got a bit dizzy. But it doesn't matter, none of that matters. I feel fantastic right now, and I know today's gonna be a special day hahaha!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.weather.weather_cl: What a beautiful day it is~ The sunlight on my skin is so warm and comfortable. It's been a while since I've breathed so freely. Feels like the whole world is smiling at me!
It's a super nice clear day! Too bad the sun's a bit blinding, but who cares. All I know is, someone like me deserves nothing less than the most dazzling sunshine!
The weather today is absolutely perfect! Perfect for an adventure, don't you think? Maybe I'll find treasure glimmering in the sunlight!

The sun is so good. So good I want to laugh, to run, to cry and scream. I tripped and scraped my knee 鈥?blood seeping out slowly 鈥?and somehow it made me feel even more alive. Pain, being alive, it's so good!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.weather.weather_ra: What a great rainy day! Running wildly through the rain without a care, completely forgetting everything. Completely, completely leaving all my troubles behind!
Rainy day? I thought I'd be able to go out and do big things today! Such a letdown... oh well, does a real strong person care about weather? Whatever.
It's a rainy day today... but so what? A rainy day can't stop me! Someone who wants to go on an adventure doesn't back down from a little difficulty!
But it's raining outside?! Out of all times?! You gotta be kidding me. Doesn't matter though, what's a little rain? I've had enough of feeling weak and powerless! Now I just want to rush out there!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_bred.war: The little animals at home had babies today! They're all so cute and full of energy! Their excited little noises one after another are so thrilling 鈥?I bet they're really happy too!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_bred.nih: So exciting~ a few new members joined the family today. Every one of them is a tiny, vibrant life 鈥?I could watch them forever. Can't help but smile.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_bred.suc: They gave birth today! I crouched beside them, watching each one come out, feeling like I'd done something amazing 鈥?shouldn't I be proud of myself for this world too? Today is such a good day.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_bred.fai: They gave birth, they gave birth! I crouched there watching for so long 鈥?they're just too adorable, I can't help but feel compassionate. I'm so excited I don't know what to do with myself. I even feel like moving them somewhere else just to calm myself down.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_died.war: It's gone... I thought today was gonna be a really good day. But it's okay, it's okay... I hope it's happier in the next world.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_died.nih: It's gone. But there's nothing I can do about it. Things are born, things die 鈥?every day in this world. To me, it just... happened.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_died.suc: Our adventure is over. It's gone, died in our adventure. But I won this adventure! I know it'd be happy for me. Next life, let's go on adventures together again, okay!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.pet_died.fai: Also, it left. Quietly, without a sound. By the time I found it, it was already gone. I just want to run a few laps outside, maybe I can forget. Forget everything, forget all the troubles...
diary.dtt.manic_phase.general.warm: It's been so long since I felt this alive. I can feel every part of my body breathing hard, taking in the fresh air. My heart is pounding, pounding, like every organ is burning through its last bit of energy, letting me run wild, run like crazy.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.general.nihilistic: I can feel the energy inside me so clearly. I know this isn't right, but what does it matter? My heart won't stop racing. If I stand still, my legs tremble like I'm having a seizure. I can't stand still, I can't stop. I HAVE to do something, I have to...
diary.dtt.manic_phase.general.successful: I haven't felt like this in so long. Energy keeps surging through me, every heartbeat so loud and clear. No one compares to me 鈥?the whole world revolves around me!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.general.failed: I tried to sit down, to breathe properly. But I just can't. So excited, so excited, so excited... even writing these words, my hand is shaking. I have to move, to run, to scream. The world will hear my voice. Like the whole world exists just for me.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.ender_dragon: Yeah! Finally took down the Ender Dragon hahahahaha! The dragon scattered into experience all across the sky, and my heart exploded with it! This is absolutely amazing!
Finally, I killed the ruler of this world. Haha... from now on, this world's story is over. Hahaha... I, this world's story is over. Am I still alive?
Of course~ beating the Ender Dragon was a piece of cake! As the world's savior, you think I couldn't handle such a small thing? The dragon egg's a souvenir 鈥?I'll take it.
Damn, the process wasn't smooth, but at least the Ender Dragon is dead in the end. This world has finally reached its end. So exciting. Truly exciting.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.raid_won.war: Ran into a raid today. Way easier than I thought. Took care of it in no time, not a scratch on the village. I feel like a real hero 鈥?like I was made for this.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.raid_won.nih: A raid came while I was all hyped up. Cleaned them up easily. Child's play, so boring. The village doesn't really do much for me anyway. Those villagers act like I was never there, just keep living their lives. Whatever, I don't care about them either.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.raid_won.suc: A raid?! No problem at all! I just charged in and killed every last pillager in two moves! Hahahaha! So satisfying! These villagers should be proud to have me around!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.topic.raid_won.fai: Got a bit careless during the raid today. The monsters got some good hits in. Good thing I was overflowing with energy, took them all out in no time. Watching their bodies disappear... I kind of wanted more.
Dammit! I lost the raid?! The whole village is destroyed... Damn, damn, damn! You all look down on me too?! I swear I'll come back for revenge...

Lost the raid today. I stood there for a long time, my hands shaking uncontrollably. I don't understand how I could lose when I'm this strong... No, I didn't lose. I definitely didn't lose. I'll get my revenge...

Those pillagers were tougher than I thought. Doesn't matter though, the villagers are all safe. Rebuilding the village is nothing, especially with me around. A little failure like this is no big deal.

Lost the raid in the end. I looked at the village, all torn up and scattered, like the pillagers were laughing at me. Hah, who's scared? Next time, I'll bury every last one of you with this village...
diary.dtt.manic_phase.closing.warm: For the first time, I feel like a day passed way too fast. I still have so much energy left and it's already dark. I have no idea if I'll be able to sleep tonight. Who cares, I'll just pull an all-nighter.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.closing.nihilistic: A day's gone by just like that. My heart is still pounding, still can't calm down no matter what. That's fine 鈥?means I should go watch the stars tonight.
diary.dtt.manic_phase.closing.successful: Hahahaha! Today was absolutely the best day of my life! I can't even remember how much treasure I found and how many great things I encountered! Why can't days like this just keep going forever?!
diary.dtt.manic_phase.closing.failed: That's it for today. I can't even tell anymore whether the exciting things I wrote about are really exciting, or if I've just lost the ability to tell the difference between a racing heart and genuine excitement. None of it matters. I think I'll try to sleep. I know it won't work.
